name: Brotherhood of Thieves

meta.next: Milly Osworth (quest), Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

summary: Across Northshire's eastern river, the Defias Brotherhood has begun to trouble the valley. Deputy Willem sends recruits to face the brigands, whose red burlap bandanas give Stormwind its first clear sign of their organized presence.

sections.title: Bandits in the Valley
sections.body:
Northshire Valley has long been a safe haven in Elwynn Forest. Stormwind guards it, and recruits and Clerics of the Holy Light train there. Lately, though, the valley's watch has grown thin. Vagrants and thieves cross the eastern river and hide near the woods. They make small camps close to the abbey.

Deputy Willem keeps order, but the guards cannot watch every corner of the valley. He needs volunteers to help hold the line.

sections.title: The Crimson Sigil
sections.body: The outlaws move together and wear matching red burlap bandanas. They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and the cloth marks their allegiance. Deputy Willem sends recruits to drive back the brigands and recover their masks. He hopes to slow their advance and learn how far the Defias have reached into the kingdom's heartland.

faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood is an organized band of brigands and outlaws active across Elwynn Forest and Westfall. At first, Northshire's authorities see bold thieves, but the bandits wear matching red burlap masks and follow coordinated leadership.

faq.q: Why is Deputy Willem asking recruits for help instead of using the Stormwind Army?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army and city guards are stretched thin across the kingdom. Unrest rises in neighboring regions, and Stormwind City's leaders are under strain. Local deputies turn to eager volunteers and novice recruits to push back the bandits.

faq.q: Where are these thieves coming from?
faq.answer: The thieves gather across the river east of the abbey. They skulk around the edges of local farmsteads and campsites near the vineyard.

faq.q: Why do the thieves wear red burlap bandanas?
faq.answer: The red burlap bandana marks a thief's allegiance to the Defias Brotherhood and hides their identity. It also signals that allegiance to fellow outlaws across the human territories.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem and the locals soon see that the bandit threat reaches farther into Northshire. Recruits then help Milly Osworth with her ruined harvest and track down Garrick Padfoot, a specific ringleader.

faq.q: Does Deputy Willem know who leads the Defias?
faq.answer: Willem does not know the full reach of the organization. He knows the brigands call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and suspects their presence near the abbey bodes ill for Stormwind.

angles.text: For humans beginning their training in Northshire, the Defias show how the Kingdom of Stormwind's safety is slipping from within.
Stormwind's authorities rely on newly arrived Alliance recruits to keep peace in Northshire while the kingdom's formal military is stretched thin.
For novice rogues, the Defias offer a glimpse of organized criminal networks working in the shadows of the human heartland.
